question: If AI writes code faster than people can check it, how do we know the code really works?
reflection: Tools that show clear proof of what works and what breaks can help people trust their own judgement instead of guessing.

sources.subject: The missing layer in AI coding: runtime validation

one_line: AI code review is moving from reading code and guessing about bugs to actually running the code and showing evidence.

top_stories.title: Code review that runs the code
top_stories.what: Greptile launched a feature that starts each proposed change in a sealed test space, tries to trigger suspected bugs, and attaches screenshots and logs to the review.
top_stories.why: Evidence of failure is easier for busy teams to act on than a vague warning, which is a lesson for any evaluation work.

top_stories.title: Small helper agents for each problem
top_stories.what: Instead of one agent doing everything, a lead reviewer sends a separate helper to test each suspected issue, so no single agent gets overloaded.
top_stories.why: Splitting work into narrow tasks is a useful design pattern for research pipelines too.

top_stories.title: Faster shipping claims
top_stories.what: The company says teams using it merge changes up to four times faster and catch three times more serious bugs than with text-only review.
top_stories.why: Vendor numbers like these should be tested locally before anyone repeats them in a business case.

saudi_lens.text: The option to run such tools inside an organisation's own private cloud matters for Saudi entities that must keep code and data inside the Kingdom.

idea.title: Proof-first quality checks
idea.pitch: Apply the same idea to survey and dashboard projects: every automated check must attach the exact failing record, not just a warning.
idea.first_step: List the five most common data errors in a recent project and write a test that shows each one.

idea_kids.title: Bug hunters club
idea_kids.pitch: A card game where children follow simple instruction cards to move a toy across a grid, then find and fix the card that sends it the wrong way.
idea_kids.first_step: Draw a 5 by 5 grid and write ten move cards, with one hidden mistake.

terms.definition: A closed area on a computer where software can run without reaching the rest of the system.
A proposed change to shared code that others review before it is accepted.

A lead agent hands narrow checks to separate helper agents.
